deployment.note: SIMPLE, 1 replica, 60-minute timeout. NO ComfyUI image exists in any market's required_images (checked live 25 Nov 2026), so this job clones ComfyUI from git inside the pre-cached TensorFlow CUDA base image (docker.io/tensorflow/tensorflow:2.17.0-gpu-jupyter, in nvidia-5090 required_images). Clone + pip install + FLUX model download are part of the measured cold start. If the clone or the FLUX download fails, record the failure honestly — do not substitute a different model.

meta.description: Profiler combo 03: ComfyUI text-to-image (FLUX.1-schnell FP8) on RTX 5090. Measures schedule, image pull, ComfyUI setup, model download, time to first image. Setup time dominates here — that is the finding, not a flaw in the measurement.
meta.name: scout-profiler-03-comfyui-flux

cmd: cd /root && git clone https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI.git && cd ComfyUI && pip install -q -r requirements.txt && python3 main.py --listen 0.0.0.0 --port 8188
